messages:
claire: FYI: VendorX marketplace listing goes public tomorrow 08:30 PT. We need a concise partner-SEV path for the launch window (first 48h). Thinking: shared ops channel + explicit paging order + warm-standby shifts. Short and actionable.

pavan: Agree. Minimal runbook is best. Suggested ordering: 1) SI/partner support in shared channel, 2) Redwood dedicated oncall, 3) Partner Eng escalation. Also add region-aware fallbacks (us-west -> eu fallback).

Lena: Can we standardize the shared channel name so programmatic hooks find it? propose: #vx-launch-ops-<env>. Pin a 1-pager with: who owns what, contact list, quick rollback steps, comms template.

claire: Good call. Also think warm-standby is helpful: rotas of 1hr shifts for first 24h, then 3hr checks through 48h. Means someone actively monitoring not just paged.

tom: ops-bot can scaffold the channel and populate pinned checklist if we pass a simple payload. Example snippet: 
```
/ops-bot create-channel vx-launch-ops-prod --pins runbook.md --invite @claire,@pavan,@Lena,@tom
/ops-bot setup-webhook alert.group=vendorx.launch severity>=high -> #vx-launch-ops-prod
```

pavan: We should also wire a dedicated PagerDuty escalation policy for the partner launch: immediate notify channel and page Redwood oncall after 10m if unresolved. Also capture customer-impact flag in alert payload.

Lena: I'll draft the pinned checklist. Minimal items: incident owner, live region(s), active customers, quick mitigation steps, rollback toggle, partner CSM comms snippet, postmortem owner rule (auto-assign if Sev2+).

claire: Nice. For routing, propose this timeline: 0-10m partner/SI triage in shared channel -> 10-30m Redwood oncall joins and handles mitigation -> 30-60m partner eng engaged if not resolved -> 60m+ escalate to warroom with partner leads.

ops-bot: action: /autocreate #vx-launch-ops-prod when alert.group == "vendorx.launch"; expose /bridge create vx-launch --participants @claire,@pavan,@Lena,@tom --template "vendor-launch-ops"

tom: Include an automated status post cadence pinned to the channel: every 30m during active incidents, auto-post status + next steps. Helps partners and CSMs stay aligned.

pavan: Also add a simple postmortem trigger: if any Sev2+ within 72h of launch, ownership assigned to partner_eng_lead + redwood_release_manager. Saves time.

Lena: I'll put together the runbook draft and checklist by EOD, drop into channel. Can someone confirm who owns the PD policy creation?

claire: I'll request PD policy from infra-oncall and share the policy id in the pinned runbook once created. After that, I'll publish a one-paragraph note in the launch announcement describing the ops runway and where to find the channel+runbook.

tom: LGTM. Also recommend we test the webhook+bridge creation now with a dry-run so we don't hit surprises during the live launch.

claire: Agree. I'll kick off a dry-run today. Thanks team — will create channel and invite you all.
